x_query.oql:
works where date >= (2015-01-01)
  and date <= (2026-08-31)
  and full text has (
    (
      5G or 6G or B5G or RAN or stemmed "5G-Advanced" or stemmed "IMT-2030"
      or stemmed "base station" or stemmed "cellular network"
      or stemmed "radio access network" or stemmed "telecom tower"
    )
    and (
      stemmed "carbon-aware"
      or stemmed "clean energy matching"
      or stemmed "renewable energy matching"
      or stemmed "renewable integration"
      or curtailment
    )
    and (perspective or review or survey)
  )
x_query.url: /works?filter=from_publication_date:2015-01-01,to_publication_date:2026-08-31,fulltext.search:5G|6G|B5G|RAN|%225G-Advanced%22|%22IMT-2030%22|%22base station%22|%22cellular network%22|%22radio access network%22|%22telecom tower%22,fulltext.search:%22carbon-aware%22|%22clean energy matching%22|%22renewable energy matching%22|%22renewable integration%22|curtailment,fulltext.search:perspective|review|survey&per_page=10
